startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Enter Zoot category or product URLs. The default is intentionally small so trial runs finish quickly.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of product records to save. Keep this low for quick smoke tests.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Hard safety limit for category, pagination, and detail requests. Prevents oversized default runs.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum parallel requests. Lower values are gentler and reduce throttling risk.

maxRequestIntervalSecs.title: Maximum request delay
maxRequestIntervalSecs.description: Maximum random delay before requests. Must be greater than or equal to minimum request delay.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Abort navigation if a response stalls longer than this.

requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.title: Request handler timeout
requestHandlerTimeoutSecs.description: Abort page handling if processing exceeds this limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy or your own proxy. Apify Proxy is recommended for Zoot.
